text:
maria_ops: :wave: FYI vendor update — they reported partial RMA for H100 fleet. Can ship 120 by air next week, remainder available in ~6 weeks by sea. Quote shows air premium +$22k, sea option lower but longer lead time. Files: proforma attached. @liam_sourcing @chen_vendor_ops
liam_sourcing: What's the air vs sea unit delta? and HS code for EU customs? we need to re-run cost model vs delay impact
chen_vendor_ops: Re-routing note: we can pool 80 units to FRA hub (faster customs). Air 120: ETA 7 business days, AWB estimate pending. Sea remainder: ETA 28-42 days. HS code we use is 85423100. Air surcharge is a flat +22k (not per unit).
rma-bot: RMA case created: RMA-2026-442 (linked). Vendor RMA id: VND-9876.
ops_sre: Cluster impact calc: losing 300 H100s reduces eu-west Dedicated ~18% at peak. Short-term mitigation: borrow 40 from spare pool, throttle non-critical workloads.
maria_ops: Good call. Does vendor accept split invoicing? We want to accept 120 air now and remainder on sea price hold.
chen_vendor_ops: Vendor agrees to split invoicing but needs deposit for air move (30% of air proforma). They asked for confirmation by EOD to lock space.
liam_sourcing: Can finance approve deposit? cc @finance (I'll ping).
maria_ops: Holding slot: approved provisional — proceed with air 120 once deposit is confirmed. Please capture AWB and commercial invoice before shipping. Also need certificate of origin and proof of export for tax.
chen_vendor_ops: Will request AWB and upload docs tonight. Tentative AWB prefix 220-XXXXX. I'll attach when available.
ops_sre: Action: create a short runbook to drain noncritical queues and mark canary pools. I'll own that.
liam_sourcing: I'll negotiate sea price hold for remaining units and confirm insurance coverage (vendor proposes carrier insurance, we need named consignee).
maria_ops: Final decision: Air 120 (approve), remainder sea on price hold. Vendor to share AWB, CI, HS code, and RMA photos. Vote with :thumbsup: to confirm.
chen_vendor_ops: :thumbsup: proceeding.
liam_sourcing: :thumbsup:
ops_sre: :thumbsup:
rma-bot: Case RMA-2026-442 updated: vendor docs pending.

Items: H100 x120 (air) / H100 x180 (sea)
